meta.name: recommendation-canvas
meta.description: Evaluate an AI product idea across outcomes, hypotheses, risks, and positioning. Use when deciding whether an AI solution deserves investment or recommendation.

copy.tagline: 评估AI产品创意是否值得投入
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要判断一个AI产品想法是否值得推荐或投资。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate whether an AI product idea deserves investment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to decide whether an AI product idea is worth recommending or investing in.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会用一张结构化画布评估你的 AI 产品创意，依次分析商业成果、客户成果、问题陈述、解决方案假设、定位、风险和价值理由，最终生成一份面向决策者的战略建议。
howto.when: 当你提出一个 AI 产品/功能创意，需要判断是否值得投资或推荐时触发。最好在完成初步用户研究后使用。

say.text: 帮我评估这个 AI 产品创意：为仓库经理提供 AI 建议的补货数量。
say.note: Claude 会引导你填写画布各板块。

say.text: 用推荐画布分析：AI 驱动的发票提醒功能，目标用户是自由设计师。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤生成完整评估。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses a structured canvas to evaluate your AI product idea, analyzing business outcomes, customer outcomes, problem framing, solution hypotheses, positioning, risks, and value justification, producing a strategic recommendation for decision-makers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you propose an AI product/feature idea and need to decide whether it deserves investment or recommendation. Best used after initial user research.

say_en.text: Evaluate this AI product idea: AI-suggested reorder quantities for warehouse managers.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the canvas.

say_en.text: Use the recommendation canvas for AI-powered invoice reminders for freelance designers.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a full assessment step by step.
